The logical flow of the code is correct. The function `merge_sorted_arrays` implements a standard merge algorithm used in merge sort. It iterates through both input lists `a` and `b`, comparing the first elements of each. It appends the smaller element to the result list `c` and removes it from its original list using `pop(0)`. This continues until one of the lists is empty. Finally, it extends `c` with the remaining elements of the non-empty list (since one list will be empty, `a or b` will return the non-empty list). The function correctly merges two sorted arrays into a single sorted array.
